properties.title: AIO Fact Check
properties.content: Question: covid no cough or fever Answer: It is possible to have COVID-19 without experiencing fever or cough. Other symptoms that may be present include:: - Fatigue - Shortness of breath - Sore throat - Runny nose or congestion - Headache - Muscle aches - Loss of taste or smell - Nausea or vomiting It's important to note that symptoms can vary depending on the individual and the specific strain of the virus. If you are experiencing any of these symptoms, it's recommended to get tested for COVID-19, especially if you have been exposed to someone who has tested positive.

Question: covid no cough or fever

Answer: It is possible to have COVID-19 without experiencing fever or cough. Other symptoms that may be present include::
- Fatigue
- Shortness of breath
- Sore throat
- Runny nose or congestion
- Headache
- Muscle aches
- Loss of taste or smell
- Nausea or vomiting
It's important to note that symptoms can vary depending on the individual and the specific strain of the virus. If you are experiencing any of these symptoms, it's recommended to get tested for COVID-19, especially if you have been exposed to someone who has tested positive.
